Name: Primordial Flesh
Description: Muddy minds make mud of men.

Name: Mortification
Description: Heed vulnerability to gain power and rejuvenation.

Name: Rapid Recitation
Description: Repeat with a swiftness your greatest abilities.

Name: Gathering Gloom
Description: Be afeared. The plague is nigh.

Description: Tread carefully for the road is perilous.

Name: Blind Faith
Description: Piety is the true map of the righteous.
